info.name: HustleHub+ Part 2 API
info.description: Auth, gig management (RBAC + ownership), bookings, transactions, and negative/security test cases for HustleHub+.

exec: // Fresh accounts every run, so the collection can be re-run without 409 conflicts.
pm.test('Returns user without password', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.user).to.have.property('email'); pm.expect(j.user).to.not.have.property('passwordHash'); });

item.name: Register with XSS payload is sanitised

exec: pm.test('Rejected or sanitised, never reflects raw script tag', () => { pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.not.include('<script>'); });
pm.test('Token returned', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.token).to.be.a('string'); pm.environment.set('clientToken', j.token); });
pm.test('Token returned', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.token).to.be.a('string'); pm.environment.set('freelancerToken', j.token); });
pm.test('Token returned', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.token).to.be.a('string'); pm.environment.set('otherFreelancerToken', j.token); });
pm.test('No user enumeration detail leaked', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.message).to.eql('Invalid email or password.'); });

item.name: Create gig with script in description is sanitised (201)

body.raw:
{
  "title": "XSS sanitisation check gig",
  "description": "<script>alert(1)</script> Please strip this script tag from the description.",
  "category": "other",
  "price": 15,
  "deliveryDays": 1
}

exec: pm.test('Script tag stripped from stored description', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.gig.description).to.not.include('<script>'); });
pm.test('Gigs array returned', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.gigs).to.be.an('array'); });

item.name: Get gig with malformed id fails (400)
Non-owner freelancer cannot update another's gig (403 ownership)
Client cannot update a gig (403 RBAC)
Non-owner freelancer cannot delete another's gig (403 ownership)
Client books a gig (201, creates transaction)

exec: pm.test('Booking and transaction returned', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.booking).to.have.property('_id'); pm.expect(j.transaction).to.have.property('reference'); pm.environment.set('bookingId', j.booking._id); });
pm.test('Transaction amount matches gig price', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.transaction.amount).to.eql(j.booking.amount); });

item.name: Freelancer cannot book a gig (403 RBAC)
Client can book the same gig again (201, separate booking)

exec: pm.test('A new, separate booking is created', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.booking._id).to.not.eql(pm.environment.get('bookingId')); });
pm.test('Transaction amount matches booking amount', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.transaction.amount).to.eql(j.booking.amount); });
pm.test('Bookings array returned', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.bookings).to.be.an('array'); });

pm.test('totalIncome equals the sum of the listed transactions', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); const sum = j.transactions.reduce((s, t) => s + t.amount, 0); pm.expect(j.totalIncome).to.eql(sum); pm.expect(j.totalIncome).to.be.above(0); });
pm.test('Every transaction is a completed booking payment', () => { pm.response.json().transactions.forEach(t => pm.expect(t.status).to.eql('completed')); });

item.name: Other freelancer's income only includes their own bookings (0)

exec: pm.test('Income from the first freelancer is NOT visible', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.totalIncome).to.eql(0); pm.expect(j.transactions).to.have.lengthOf(0); });
